scope: Broaden DWG/DXF comparison to an explicit-mesh consumer failure and its merged fix; refine the existing 3D consumer gate without misclassifying renderer resource behavior as file-format support.

method.kind: Primary-source issue, merged pull request, application README/tessellation documentation, and local plan cross-check
method.evidenceBoundary: The merged PR and project documentation describe one consumer-specific GPU-renderer failure/fix and declared tessellation routes. No peer binary was run, no drawing was obtained, and no local parser/writer behavior or semantic geometry was reproduced.

evidence.topic: Large explicit-mesh render failure is a consumer resource issue, not a file-format limit
observed: The issue describes a customer 2.42 GB mesh-heavy DWG that triggered a crash while enabling layers in a shaded view.
Merged PR #404 attributes the crash to aggregating 3DFACE and PolyfaceMesh/PolygonMesh fill data into one wgpu vertex buffer above the device's 256 MiB default max_buffer_size.
The fix splits the fill streams on whole-triangle boundaries and installs an error handler so GPU validation failures degrade rendering rather than aborting the application.
The PR reports a locally generated 1.2-million-face DXF as a smoke workload for the fixed renderer; later issue activity distinguishes slow save/autosave behavior from the original rendering crash.
doesNotEstablish: A DWG/DXF parser defect or a universal file-format size/triangle limit.
General renderer stability or performance on other hardware and applications.
ACIS B-rep validity, ACdS association, or complete solid rendering.
evidence.planUse: At the existing composed consumer gate only, separate parse/open success from selected-view rendering and record consumer-specific resource behavior for a modest locally generated explicit-mesh workload. Do not import the customer drawing or copy the wgpu budget into libdxfrw limits.

evidence.topic: OpenCADStudio declares separate explicit-mesh and ACIS rendering paths
observed: The tessellation guide lists Face3D/Mesh/PolyfaceMesh/PolygonMesh as direct triangle/line emission.
It documents Solid3D/Region/Body/Surface as a kernel B-rep lift with a per-surface LOD fallback when a face cannot be represented, and says incomplete results are marked.
The current application README advertises DWG/DXF read/write and ACIS tessellation, while prior plan research classifies its codec as ACadRust-family lineage.
doesNotEstablish: An independent DWG parser lineage from ACadRust or a second independent parser vote.
That fallback rendering preserves every body/face or proves a valid closed B-rep.
Application-level claims for libdxfrw, FreeCAD, LibreCAD, or LibreCAD_3.
evidence.planUse: Keep explicit-mesh rendering and ACIS/modeler rendering in separate consumer evidence rows. Track source-body/face denominators and fallback/incomplete state; retain payload/owner closure and independent geometry as separate gates.
